name: KiwiFil
summary: New Zealand recycled-filament maker founded by Eva Hakansson and Bill Dube that has extruded since 2020, starting on a repurposed straw extruder. It sells recycled PLA, silk rPLA, 100% recycled rPETG, an rPCTG-rPETG high-temperature blend and NZ-wool-filled WoolyFil in 1.75 and 2.85 mm, and runs a spool-return programme.

product_lines.name: rPLA pro
product_lines.notes: Recycled PLA, 'pro' grade; mapped per the PLA Pro convention, since the toughening is not documented.

product_lines.name: WoolyFil
product_lines.notes: Filament filled with NZ wool; the base polymer is not stated in the notes and no wool-fill id exists.

product_lines.name: Glitter
product_lines.notes: Glitter filament; the base polymer is not stated in the notes.

additional_notes: Recycled-material focus. Also sells PLA and PETG pellets. Moving from cardboard to refillable plastic spools. Retailed in NZ/AU by PB Tech, which is a retail channel rather than an OEM tie. No white-label relationships found, so oem_relationships is empty. Legal entity name unknown.

provenance.conflicts: City and legal entity not stated in the notes. The base polymers of WoolyFil and the glitter line are unverified.
